verdict.rationale: Benchmark documents its own campaign reporting: per-link click data, peak engagement times, and campaign results that can be pulled via the API into BI tools. That covers clicks per campaign at a basic level. Missing for 10: explicit open, unsubscribe and conversion metrics, per-automation-step reporting, over-time trend views, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a marketer, I can read opens, clicks, unsubscribes, and conversions per campaign and per automation step, over time

citations.quote: See which links are driving the most clicks.
Pull campaign results into your BI tool, your weekly digest, or whatever dashboard you actually look at.
Identify peak engagement times to optimize your sending schedule.
